_comment: Regular-grid example for Fe NLTE intensity synthesis using per-abundance ASCII departure files.
_note: This example combines the Fe NLTE ASCII-departure selection workflow with Intensity-mode output.

mu_range creates target-mu rows in the regular grid; the synthesized runtime config is materialized with mu_sampling.mode='nearest' so each row keeps the closest mu from the Turbospectrum Intensity output.
Populate the NLTE ASCII departure directory first (for example with scripts/export_nlte_grid_ascii.py) before running a full synthesis job.
When synthesized, turbvel is preserved as a numeric parameter column alongside vmicro in the final spectra Zarr.

synthesis._mu_range_note: Requested mu targets used when post-selecting from the Turbospectrum intensity output.

_note: These fields are copied into the generated grid and used at synthesis time.
For Fe, abundance_column='feh' with abundance_scale='relative' maps A(Fe)=solar_fe+[Fe/H] on the Magg abundance scale used by the synthesis runner.
match='nearest' chooses the closest available _abu+X.XXX ASCII file for the selected model atmosphere.
Base synthesis runtime config used by synthesize_spectra_from_zarr.py.
overrides lets this example turn on NLTE Fe and point at the repository NLTE info file.

outputs._note: run_root is resolved relative to this config unless absolute; output paths under outputs/... are resolved relative to run_root.

runtime._note: rows_per_shard helps amortize Turbospectrum startup overhead on HPC and works with the regular-grid PBS array mode.
